description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this impressive three bedroom, three bathroom property, arranged over two floors.

Offering generous living space throughout, this large property boasts a modern feel and stylish finish, making it an ideal home for professional tenants.

The property benefits from three well proportioned bedrooms, three bathrooms and spacious living accommodation, providing plenty of space and convenience.

Ideally located within walking distance of Newcastle City Centre, the property is perfectly positioned for easy access to the city-s shops, restaurants, universities and local amenities.

Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the size, location and modern finish this property has to offer.
